summary: Implemented the missing ordered selection-to-existing-ordinary-pile seam. Shared PILE_GAP movement binds target card/pile/position, prefix and untouched right neighbor with explicit pending-member exclusions. Normal drag and Actions routes lower A then B onto X to [A,B,X] through immediate individual production session requests with one invocation and independent outcomes. Same-pile no-op/reorder, whole-selection capacity, exact replay/inverse, partial conflict outcomes and unrelated live fields are covered. Latest retained evidence has 33 distinct passing host tests, including one actual PostgreSQL FIFO/SQL/history/revision seam; normal APK compiles and is inspected. This is source implementation, not independent verification, native I16/B4 completion or release acceptance.

repairs.result: Added PILE_GAP and targetCardId/pendingIds on the existing individual MoveDestination. Validates UUID/distinct/bounded pending operands and disallows them on other insertions. The existing guarded movement processor checks exact source, addressed target membership at captured pile/position, full actual capacity and projected gap adjacency excluding only named pending members. It inserts after the actual prefix, retaining unmoved members' relative order and common placement. No bulk action, reservation, new transaction, acknowledgement barrier, whole-card lock or changed Stack guard. Existing exact movement transitions and GameplayHistory replay/inverse work unchanged.

Removed the multi-card rejection and disabled gesture path. Preflights the complete unique membership, captures untouched right neighbor, then emits source-ordered requests using stable prefix IDs, pending IDs and one invocation. Already correctly placed members remain prefix anchors without requests/nodes. Each enqueued request reaches the existing GameSession immediately; predictions remain provisional. The real Actions screen now offers capacity-valid existing-pile choices remembered with their captured target/source; drag uses the same CardPile intent. No target substitution or local authoritative board was added.

First combined command reached shared tests and failed only prefixOperandsAreTypedBoundedAndNotAcceptedOnOtherDestinations: malformed Stack-destination test expected invalidInput, but the pre-existing earlier semantic Stack guard correctly returned stackConflict. Supplied the matching Stack digest so this test reaches its intended insertion-shape assertion. No production check or assertion was weakened. Retained the actual failed command and XML, then reran only this changed shared suite plus still-unexecuted Android/server/APK scopes.
